title: He used to say 'ball'
objective: Connect families to early intervention programs, which provide evaluations and link them to services such as service coordination, social work and home visits
secondaryObjectives: Legal and policy frameworks: IDEA early intervention and school-based services

Know developmental red flags that need immediate evaluation: no social smile by 2 months, no babbling or pointing by 12 months, no words by 16 months, no 2-word phrases by 24 months, and any loss of skills

brief.situation: 14:00 in an outpatient pediatric clinic. You are the physical therapist. Leo, 16 months, is at his last visit for congenital muscular torticollis, which has resolved. As you wrap up, his mother says he 'used to say mama, dada and ball and wave bye-bye' but stopped over the last two months. A relative told her boys talk late and to wait for the 18-month checkup.
handover: His pediatrician's next well visit is in two months.
Clinic policy: share developmental concerns with the family and, with their permission, the child's pediatrician the same day; give families the state early intervention program's contact.
howItWorks: The clock runs in simulated time; study pace runs three simulated minutes per real minute. Pause any time.
Each check takes the time on its button. Decide what the findings mean, what to stop or start, and who must know.
Partway through you are asked to write your reasoning. A debrief scores what you did.

why.question: What does Leo's lost speech and waving mean, and what do you do?

parts.label: What and why
parts.criteria: Loss of skills he once had (three words and waving), with no response to his name or pointing, is a developmental red flag needing evaluation now, whatever his motor progress.
parts.modelAnswer: He lost words and waving he used to have, and doesn't respond to his name or point. Losing skills is a red flag, even with good motor skills.

parts.label: What I do
parts.criteria: Explain early intervention (a state program the family can call directly, which evaluates and links families to services), help the family call now, and with permission call the pediatrician today; document.
parts.modelAnswer: Tell her about early intervention and help her call, get her OK to call the pediatrician today, and write it up.

scoring.modelReasoning: Any loss of skills is a developmental red flag that needs prompt evaluation; 'don't wait'. Early intervention programs, set up under IDEA, provide evaluations and link families to services such as service coordination, social work and home visits. The family can call the state program directly. Connect Leo's family now and, with permission, tell his pediatrician the same day.
